subject.title: Surface internal system messages in a distinct UI block instead of normal chat bubbles

question: Should visible runtime/system-originated messages be hidden by default, rendered as a dedicated diagnostic block, or continue through ordinary chat grouping?
rationale: The current source supports multiple implementation shapes, but the choice affects transcript projection, Control UI/WebChat rendering, TUI parity, and restart-continuation behavior, so automation should not pick the product policy by itself.

options.title: Define shared audience contract
options.body: Choose a core hidden-vs-diagnostic audience model first, then implement Gateway projection and surface rendering from that contract.

options.title: Hide runtime internals
options.body: Treat system/runtime-originated prompts as agent-only unless a source explicitly opts into user-visible diagnostics.

options.title: Style current system rows only
options.body: Add a distinct system block for role system rows without changing visibility semantics, accepting that some agent-only text may still be exposed.

recommendation.title: Define shared audience contract
recommendation.body: Choose a core hidden-vs-diagnostic audience model first, then implement Gateway projection and surface rendering from that contract.

likelyOwner.reason: The strongest recent history is on Gateway display projection and Control UI chat rendering, which are central to the policy decision.
